{{Top|leg}}
[[File:9pod9.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke and Leia in a life pod from the ''Falcon''.]]
A '''lifeboat''' was a large [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that was common on large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The boats could hold between ten and fifty individuals and some were considered to be [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in their own right. Life boats were better stocked than escape pods, and provided support for passengers for a longer duration. Some models were equipped with [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]], and some were even fitted with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The escape pods carried by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] included a two-person lifeboat which [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] took to the surface of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]].

Although not strictly lifeboats, the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', the official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], compared the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to that of lifeboats floating adrift in the airless void that was realspace.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
